question: According to the World Economic Forum, based on the information received till March 2021, which of the following countries had the largest number of languages spoken in the region?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Papua new guinea.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Papua new guinea**

__
 
• **Papua New Guinea has the largest number of languages ​​spoken in the world, more than 800.**
 
• It is the number one country in the world in the index of diversity in language and dialect.
 
• If you choose any two people in this country, then one thing will be decided, the mother tongue of both will be different.
 
• The** language of business in the country is English and the majority of the people living here are Australians.**
 
• According to Clara Raven, you'll also hear **Tok Paison, which is mixed English and is one of the country's four national official languages.**
 
• **Tok Paisan is the fourth language apart from English, Hirimoto and Papua New Guinea.**
